Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIXT.1.1 (Always unencrypted, must be first field in message)

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: (Always unencrypted, must be second field in message)

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: (Always unencrypted, must be third field in message)

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Integer message sequence number. Sequence numbers are initialized at the start of each FIX session starting at 1 (one) and increment throughout the session.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Always required for retransmitted messages, whether prompted by the sending system or as the result of a resend request. Indicates possible retransmission of message with this sequence number

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: SenderCompID as assigned by Nasdaq Nordic (MPID in INET, FIX Session ID in NDTS). Outbound from Nasdaq: From 56 on the original inbound message.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: Trader ID (User ID). This tag is not required on session level messages but is required for application level messages. Outbound from Nasdaq: INET: Indicator to denote which host system was involved (S = Order message, T = Trade Reporting message). NDTS: N/A

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: UTC. Outbound from Nasdaq: Please note that this time is the time the message left the FIX application. It has no relevancy to execution time, reject time, or cancel time in the destination systems.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: As per the information provided by Nasdaq Nordic. Outbound from Nasdaq: From 49 on the original inbound message.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: INET: Required 1-character that identifies this entry as an order entry or trade reporting message (S = Order message, T = Trade Reporting message). NDTS: Optional indicator to denote client software version. Outbound from Nasdaq: Receiving party's Trader ID (User ID), if this message is a query/response message. From 50 on the original inbound message. Not specified for On-Behalf-Of message responses. This tag is not required on session level messages.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: Ignored. Outbound from Nasdaq: N/A

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: Service Bureaus use this field to submit their customer's MPID. This value will be returned to you in tag 128 on the outbound message. Please note that while it is possible for you submit a chain of transactions with inconsistent values for this tag in different messages, you are strongly advised not to do so. Outbound from Nasdaq: N/A

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: When applicable, this tag holds the User ID (Trader ID) for the on behalf of firm. Outbound from Nasdaq: N/A

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for message resent as a result of a ResendRequest. If data is not available set to same value as SendingTime. UTC

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: N/A. Outbound from Nasdaq: For drop and service bureau on behalf of messages, this field contains the service bureau's customer's MPID.

Field.Name: DeliverToSubID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: N/A. Outbound from Nasdaq: For drop and service bureau on behalf of messages, this field contains the value entered in tag 116 on the inbound message.

Field.Name: DeliverToLocationID
Field.Description: Inbound to Nasdaq: N/A. Outbound from Nasdaq: For drop messages, this field (if provided) specify the account / port ID used when originally sending the message. Use together with OrigClOrdID [41] and DeliverToCompID [128] to chain an order modification to the original order.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Where possible, coded message that includes an indicator and text to explain reason for rejection: Invalid tag number; Required tag missing; Tag not defined for this message type; Undefined Tag; Tag specified without a value; Value is incorrect (out of range) for tag; Incorrect data format for value; Signature problem; Tag CompID problem; SendingTime accuracy problem; Invalid value for MsgType tag; Repeating group fields out of order; Incorrect number in group count for repeating group

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: The tag number of the FIX field being referenced.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: The MsgType of the FIX message being referenced.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject message.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required when the heartbeat is the result of a Test Request message. It is the TestReqID received from the Test Request message.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Not supported. Must be 0.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat Interval in seconds - should be greater than 10 and less than or equal to 60.

Field.Name: DefaultApplVerID
Field.Description: The default version of FIX messages used in this session.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Date/Time combination

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Beginning sequence number of Requested Message

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Ending sequence number of Requested Message

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: Next expected sequence number

Field.Name: TradeReportID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of a trade capture report. Must be unique per day per connector across all messages. 20-character alphanumeric.

Field.Name: TradeReportRefID
Field.Description: Required for Trade Report Cancel Requests ([856] = 6). Contains the value indicated in TradeReportID [571] in the original trade entry message.

Field.Name: TradeReportType
Field.Description: Used to identify message type, type of trade report.

Field.Name: TradeHandlingInstr
Field.Description: Specified how the TradeCaptureReport should be handled by the respondent. Inbound to Nasdaq Nordic limited to 1 and 2.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Required for trade break requests, [856] = 7 and not applicable in other cases. Specifies the identifier of the locked-in trade to be broken.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: OrderBookID or [N/A]

Field.Name: SecurityIDSource
Field.Description: Required if identifying the security with ISIN (SecurityID [48]) instead of OrderBookID (Symbol [55]).

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: ISIN code for the instrument.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Required if identifying security with ISIN (SecurityID [48]) instead of OrderBookID (Symbol [55]).

Field.Name: SubMktID
Field.Description: Market Segment number. Required if identifying security with ISIN (SecurityID [48]) instead of OrderBookID (Symbol [55]).

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this fill. Limited to six digits and six decimals (999 999.999999).

Field.Name: LastQty
Field.Description: Quantity bought/sold on this fill. If the trade is for clearing, limited to ten digits.

Field.Name: SettleDate
Field.Description: Specific date of trade settlement (settlement date).

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time when the message was initiated/released by the trader or the trading system.

Field.Name: TradeType
Field.Description: Required for Trade Entry.

Field.Name: VenueType
Field.Description: Corresponds to MMT Level 1 - Market Mechanism

Field.Name: MatchType
Field.Description: Corresponds to MMT Level 2 - Trading Mode

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: Type of trade.

Field.Name: SecondaryTrdType
Field.Description: Type of trade. Used in addition to TrdType [828].

Field.Name: TertiaryTrdType
Field.Description: Type of trade. Used in addition to TrdType [828] and SecondaryTrdType [855].

Field.Name: ExecMethod
Field.Description: Specifies how the transaction was executed. Corresponds to MMT Level 3.7 - Transaction Type: Off-Book Automated Indicator

Field.Name: TradePublishIndicator
Field.Description: Corresponds to MMT Level 4.1 - Publication Mode / Post-Trade Deferral: Reason

Field.Name: TrdRptStatus
Field.Description: Status of Trade Report. Only applicable when the venue confirms the receipt of a TCR sent by the client.

Field.Name: TradeReportRejectReason
Field.Description: Reason inbound message was rejected.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: In applicable cases, specifies the cause of the reject

Field.Name: TradeReportTransType
Field.Description: Transaction type. Corresponds to MMT Level 3.4 - Transaction Type: Modification Indicator

Field.Name: PartyID

Field.Name: PartyRole
Field.Description: Executing firm is mandatory. Contra Firm is required for one-sided reports. Clearing Firm is a pass-through field. (Note that the field is not forwarded to the CCP).
